decisions.decision: Elevated Sovereign Search Protocol from a skill to a core engine service (SovereignSearchService) to enable autonomous escalation and degraded-mode fallback.

continuation: Sovereign Search Partnership implemented. I've evolved SovereignSearcher from a simple semantic retriever into a core engine service (SovereignSearchService) that implements the 5-Tier Protocol (T0-T4). T0 is now wired to MemoryStore's Hybrid RRF search. Ready to synchronize with @researcher on the 'Degraded Mode' trigger and the final integration of T1, T2, and T4 providers into the service.
